#   arduino/libraries/SocAudio/src/SocAudio.h
# Boards of the KIT SoC Lab NEORV32 platform: the Lab 3 SoC on the ZedBoard
# (NEORV32 v1.11 rv32imc_zicsr at 98.304 MHz, code in SPI flash via XIP at
# 0xE000_0000, 16 KB DMEM, audio peripheral at 0xFFD0_0000).
# FQBN: soclab:neorv32:zedboard[:build=board|sim,timescale=1000|100|10|1,voices=1..16,opt=os|o2,openocd=local|remote]

# linker flash size (arduino/build.mk ROM_SIZE: the flash model of labs/lab3/sim/tb_soc.v)

# upload (untested on hardware): GDB through a running OpenOCD server (platform.txt)

# The server must already be running. This menu changes only normal Upload's
# GDB endpoint; it does not start OpenOCD or change Upload Using Programmer.

zedboard.menu.openocd.local.tools.gdb.server=127.0.0.1:3333
zedboard.menu.openocd.remote=Remote 192.0.2.1:3333 (edit boards.local.txt)
# Personal IP/port and menu label belong in boards.local.txt; see README.
zedboard.menu.openocd.remote.tools.gdb.server=192.0.2.1:3333

# Build: as arduino/Makefile without / with SIM=1. Board: real time, Serial at the
# baud rate given to Serial.begin. Simulation: image for labs/lab3/sim/tb_soc.v of
# the course repo, Serial at 1228800 baud (80 clocks per bit) whatever Serial.begin
# gets, millis()/delay() scaled by the time scale menu (audio stays at 48 kHz).
zedboard.menu.build.board=Board (real time)
zedboard.menu.build.board.build.arduino_sim=0
zedboard.menu.build.board.build.time_scale=1
# Only the simulation testbench consumes .hex; board builds need no Python.

zedboard.menu.build.sim=Simulation (tb_soc: UART 1228800 baud, time scaled)
zedboard.menu.build.sim.build.arduino_sim=1
zedboard.menu.build.sim.build.time_scale={build.sim_time_scale}

# KR260 Lab3: 128 KiB BRAM at 0xE0000000, 16 KiB DMEM.
kr260.name=KIT SoC Lab - KR260 Lab3 + NEORV32
kr260.build.core=neorv32
kr260.build.variant=zedboard_soc
kr260.build.board=SOCLAB_NEORV32_KR260
kr260.build.mcu=rv32imc_zicsr_zifencei
kr260.build.rom_size=128k
kr260.upload.tool=gdb
kr260.upload.tool.default=gdb
kr260.upload.protocol=gdb
kr260.upload.maximum_size=131072
kr260.upload.maximum_data_size=16384
# Resume the BRAM entry point after loading, with either r6 or UART bootROM.
kr260.tools.gdb.upload.pattern="{path}{cmd}" -batch -nx {upload.verbose} -ex "set confirm off" -ex "target extended-remote {server}" -ex "monitor reset halt" -ex "load" -ex "monitor resume 0xE0000000" -ex "detach" "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"
